comment: Every path that is allowed to grow declares a ceiling and a policy. Anything undeclared over undeclared_alert_gib is reported, which is how the next 39 GiB surprise gets caught at 5 GiB. Policies: lru_cap (evict oldest files to cap), dir_lru_cap (evict whole subdirs), age_prune (drop top-level entries older than age_days), keep_newest (retain N newest matches), report_only (measure and alert, never delete). Operator-specific paths (a private tool's cache, a personal local project) do NOT belong here: this file is tracked and this repo is destined to be public. Declare them in the gitignored overlay docs_private/ssd_budget.local.json, which enforce_ssd_budget.ts merges additively by path.
